subject.title: feat(setup): rename Crestodian to OpenClaw system agent

question: Should protocol v4 preserve the shipped `crestodian.*` methods and capability as compatibility aliases, or should this rename become a versioned breaking protocol transition with a coordinated client-upgrade policy?
rationale: The code can implement either direction, but only an owner can decide whether independently upgraded gateways and native/CLI clients must remain interoperable under protocol v4.

options.title: Preserve v4 aliases
options.body: Keep the retired methods and capability mapped to the new handlers through a documented compatibility window, with mixed-version tests.

options.title: Version the transition
options.body: Bump or negotiate the protocol and publish a coordinated upgrade contract that prevents mismatched clients from completing a compatible handshake.

options.title: Pause the rename
options.body: Keep Crestodian identifiers until the system-agent phases and upgrade strategy can land as one coordinated product transition.

recommendation.title: Preserve v4 aliases
recommendation.body: Keep the retired methods and capability mapped to the new handlers through a documented compatibility window, with mixed-version tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and parent proposal connect this owner most directly to the system-agent direction and current setup/inference behavior.
